reason: My order book is full for months, so a missed call doesn't cost me anything, and I already sort things out with people on WhatsApp myself. Paying 990 € plus 149 € a month to collect even more enquiries I can't take on makes no sense for me.
objection: My customers want to talk to a person, not get an automatic text, and I don't need more leads. I need fewer interruptions. And I'm not handing my customer calls to a brand-new company with no customers.
would_change_my_mind: If it sorted out and turned away the jobs I can't take, and answered existing customers about appointments, so it saved me phone time instead of bringing in more enquiries. And a setup under 300 € with no long setup project.
